# Chasing the Donkey

> > A comprehensive Balkans and Southeast Europe travel blog offering destination guides, cultural recipes, expat tips, and travel planning resources across 12+ countries.

Chasing the Donkey is a travel blog specializing in Balkans and Southeast European destinations with practical guides for travelers and expatriates. The site covers individual country travel guides, regional comparisons, traditional cuisine, and lifestyle tips for living in the region.

## Key Topics

- Balkans travel guide
- Croatia
- Turkey/Istanbul
- Serbia
- Bosnia-Herzegovina
- Montenegro
- Greece
- Slovenia
- Bulgaria
- Romania
- Albania
- Kosovo
- North Macedonia
- Travel planning
- Expat living
- Traditional recipes

## Regional Guides

- [Balkans Travel Guide: 12 Balkan Countries Tips & Information](https://www.chasingthedonkey.com/balkan-countries-list-balkans-travel-guide): Comprehensive Balkans travel guide covering 12 countries with tips
- [Balkans Travel Guide - Balkans & Beyond](https://www.chasingthedonkey.com/balkans-travel-guide): Regional Balkans travel guide with planning and comparisons

## Country Travel Guides

- [Croatia Travel Blog](https://www.chasingthedonkey.com/croatia-travel-blog): Croatia travel guide with Zagreb, Pula and travel planning
- [Serbia Travel Blog - Novi Sad, Belgrade & Beyond](https://www.chasingthedonkey.com/serbia-travel-blog): Serbia travel guide featuring Belgrade, Novi Sad and destinations
- [Bosnia-Herzegovina Travel Blog - Mostar & Beyond](https://www.chasingthedonkey.com/bosnia-and-herzegovina-travel-blog): Bosnia-Herzegovina travel guide featuring Mostar and destinations
- [Montenegro Travel Blog - Kotor, Budva & Beyond](https://www.chasingthedonkey.com/montenegro-travel-blog): Montenegro travel guide covering Kotor, Budva and beaches
- [Albania Travel Blog - Sarandë, Berat & Beyond](https://www.chasingthedonkey.com/albania-travel-blog): Albania travel guide covering Sarandë, Berat and destinations
- [Greece Travel Blog - Athens, Islands & Beyond](https://www.chasingthedonkey.com/greece-travel-blog): Greece travel guide covering Athens, islands and travel tips
- [Turkey Travel Blog - Istanbul, Bursa & Beyond](https://www.chasingthedonkey.com/turkey-travel-blog): Turkey travel guide covering Istanbul, Bursa and attractions
- [Slovenia Travel Blog - Ljubljana, Piran & Beyond](https://www.chasingthedonkey.com/slovenia-travel-blog): Slovenia travel guide featuring Ljubljana, Piran and attractions
- [Romania Travel Blog - Brasov, Bucharest & Beyond](https://www.chasingthedonkey.com/romania-travel-blog): Romania travel guide covering Brasov, Bucharest and itineraries
- [Bulgaria Travel Blog - Sofia, Burgas & Beyond](https://www.chasingthedonkey.com/bulgaria-travel-blog): Bulgaria travel guide covering Sofia, Burgas and attractions
- [Kosovo Travel Blog - Prizren, Pristina & Beyond](https://www.chasingthedonkey.com/kosovo-travel-blog): Kosovo travel guide featuring Prizren, Pristina and attractions
- [North Macedonia - Skopje, Bitola & Beyond](https://www.chasingthedonkey.com/north-macedonia-travel-blog): North Macedonia travel guide featuring Skopje and day trips
